==Notes==
* This skill combines well with [[Keen Arrow (PvP)]], [[Vicious Attack]] and [["Find Their Weakness!" (PvP)]].
* Works well in [[Party|parties]] with [[minion]]s as all the minions are affected.

==Trivia==
*The skill name derives from a quote by [[w:Minsc|Minsc]] (from the RPG Baldur's Gate) regarding his miniature giant space hamster Boo, in which he urges: "Go for the eyes, Boo, GO FOR THE EYES!"
*The [[skill icon]] resembles the [http://www.guildwars.com/products/guildwars/gallery/poster/e3_2003.php poster art].
